quarterly_data.quarter: Cerebras press release: Cerebras Unveils CS-4: Up to 30 Times Faster than GPU-based (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cerebras unveiled the CS-4, the first member of its next-generation Nexus rack-scale platform, built from three new Wafer Scale Engine 3 Turbo (WSE-3T) chips: 750 PFLOPs of AI compute, 7.2 terabits per second of I/O and 129.6 petabytes per second of memory bandwidth. Company claims: up to twice as fast as the CS-3, up to 10x more throughput per watt, and more than 4,400 tokens per second per user on GPT-OSS-120B, up to 30 times faster than GPU solutions. Each WSE-3T has four trillion transistors and 44GB of on-wafer SRAM, doubles compute to 250 PFLOPS per wafer and memory bandwidth to 43.2 petabytes per second; the new 'backpack' compute assembly has 50% fewer components; Direct Wafer Links cut wafer-to-wafer latency to as low as two microseconds and the I/O supports disaggregated inference with partners like AMD Helios and AWS Trainium. 'First CS-4 shipments begin this quarter.'
